column1: # The app manifest: every app the dotfiles install (install-apps.sh) or bundle
# (portable build-tools.sh). One row per binary; whitespace-separated, "-" for none.
# Blank lines and "#" lines are comments, except the header below.
# Columns:
#   name     binary name, installed as "name".
#   tier     install-apps tier: core, extra, desktop; "-" = portable bundles only.
#   portable which portable zsh bundles ship it: zssh (ssh), dev (devcontainer),
#            "zssh,dev" (both) or "-". A dev row needs a release download
#            or a static: build.
#   apt pacman dnf brew
#            package name per package manager; "-" = not packaged.
#   release  GitHub owner/name to download a release binary from with eget.
#   file     binary to extract from the release asset (an eget --file glob).
#   assets   "|"-separated alternatives tried in order; each alternative is a
#            ","-separated list of eget --asset filters (^ excludes); "-"
#            means no filters. Package and checksum files are always
#            excluded. eget picks among what is left using --system, but a
#            filter that leaves one asset wins even for the wrong CPU, so
#            every download is checked with elf_arch and the next alternative
#            tried. On armv7l each alternative is first tried with an extra
#            "armv7" filter.
#   build    how build-tools.sh makes it for a profile (see its header) and
#            install-apps --build cargo: crate:CRATE[:BIN][:ARGS],
#            go:MODULE[//SUBPKG], cross:NAME (built with cross/NAME.sh ARCH
#            OUT, e.g. tmux with the Jetson Yocto SDK), static:NAME (a static
#            musl binary built from source by the portable build with
#            static/NAME.sh ARCH OUT, for tools with no release binary; hosts
#            use the package and skip it without one), or "-" = take the
#            release download. Rows sharing a crates.io name with another
#            project (usbtree), needing C libraries the static build lacks
#            (rustnet: libpcap, atuin: OpenSSL, tracexec: libbpf/libelf,
#            comchan: fontconfig), not building against musl (cyme),
#            crashing rustc under fat LTO (zellij) or having go.mod replace
#            directives go install refuses (ctop) use the release.
#            pipx:SPEC (install-apps only, never bundled) runs
#            `pipx install SPEC`; the pipx row is installed with the packages.
#            A crate: build with no package or release (lsnet) is installed
#            only with --build cargo.
# Static musl builds come first so binaries run on older glibc (JetPack 4 is
# Ubuntu 18.04). A tool with no build for an arch is skipped with a warning.
# name           tier     portable  apt             pacman         dnf              brew            release                         file           assets                                build
